summary: SIEM feed c083_broker_nic is degraded by severe path loss: BROKER-A port 1/5 is saturated at 100% of 1 Gbps average (bursts higher) dropping 17.15% on egress, plus SIEM eth1 dropping an additional 4.19% on ingest due to capture overload.

findings.root_cause: Egress oversubscription at BROKER-A 1/5 to SIEM: average load is 100% of the 1 Gbps tool port so bursts are discarded (1,552,500 packets, 17.15% lost). Downstream the SIEM's own 1 Gbps capture interface (eth1) is also overrun and discarded 314,520 received packets (4.19% lost), indicating both broker egress congestion and tool ingest capacity exceeded.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM receives incomplete traffic (~21% combined loss). Events, flows and alerts will be missing or uncorrelated, creating blind spots and reducing detection coverage for security analytics.

params.preserve: DNS, HTTP, TLS handshakes, authentication, firewall and proxy logs
params.drop_or_sample: bulk data transfer, streaming, backup replication

recommended_fix.why: SIEM needs_full_payload=false and needs_both_directions=false per profile, so traffic can be filtered to security-relevant flows to fit the 1 Gbps tool port and stop both broker egress drops and SIEM eth1 ingest drops without upgrading hardware. If filtered load still exceeds 1 Gbps, add load_balance or tool_capacity upgrade.
